messages:
maria: Quick sync / brief thread: need a condensed battlecard + landing funnel rules for the Nov webinar. Target audience: platform teams and infra PMs. Can we align on 5-minute talking points and handoff logic?
aj: I sketched a 90s opener: "Redwood unifies serving across hosted, reserved, and private so you get consistent latency, cost, and controls without building the glue." Short and punchy.
devon: Love. For the competitor callouts I propose 3 quick zingers (one-liners):
- Managed cloud endpoints: simple onboarding but unpredictable per-token costs at scale.
- LLM API vendors: fastest for prototyping but limited deployment choices + hidden perf cliffs.
- Infra-only runtimes: flexible but requires stitching orchestration, monitoring, and paging.
samir: For the lead routing matrix I want deterministic rules that tie to product tiers + intent. Draft mapping:
- intent: enterprise_demo OR company.size >= 2000 -> route: AE_enterprise, SLA: 48h, touch: high
- intent: pilot OR usage_projection >= 500k tokens/month -> route: SDR_trial, SLA: 72h, touch: medium
- intent: docs_help OR research -> route: docs-site + community, SLA: n/a, touch: low
- tech_contact + perf_question -> route: platform_eng triage, SLA: 24h, touch: high
(we should include an automated tag when inbound includes words: latency, p95, SLA, private)
elaine: Webinar headlines (short list):
- "From PoC to SLA: Serving LLMs at Scale"
- "Same API, Predictable Performance, Lower Spend"
- "Redwood Runtime: Stop stitching. Start serving."
My vote: #1 or #3. #2 feels generic.
tara: Marketing ops note: landing page needs a select field for "primary intent" and a hidden input for token estimate. This feeds the routing rules. Also add a checkbox for private deployment interest (toggles AE_enterprise).
ops-bot: Reminder: Please attach benchmark artifact ID bmk-2027-11-10 when making public claims.
aj: Benchmarks — ask to ops: can we get trimmed p95 latency vs top-3 cloud endpoints and per-1M token cost delta for a 6-turn chat pattern? Need numbers by EOD for slides.
maria: @ops-bot cc @eng-infra — we need the trimmed table and a one-liner describing test rig (seq len, batch config). Also need confirmation we can claim "X% lower unit cost in typical chat workloads" or else use ranges.
devon: Draft talking points for slide (customer-facing):
1) Predictable economics: routing + quantization profiles reduce unit cost without surprise regressions.
2) Deployment parity: same SDK & telemetry across hosted/dedicated/private so you can shift without rewrite.
3) Reliability-first: built-in fallbacks and SLO routing keep products online even under capacity pressure.
samir: I converted the routing into simple pseudocode for the landing page webhook:
```
function routeInbound(form) {
  if (form.private_interest === true || form.company_size >= 2000) return 'AE_enterprise';
  if (form.intent === 'pilot' || form.estimated_tokens >= 500000) return 'SDR_trial';
  if (form.intent === 'perf_question') return 'platform_eng';
  return 'self_serve';
}
```
elaine: Slide copy needs the competitor callouts short enough for a single bullet each. Devon can you shorten to 8-10 words?
devon: Sure:
- Cloud: easy start, variable cost at scale.
- LLM APIs: prototype fast, lock-in for production.
- Infra runtimes: flexible, heavy ops burden.
aj: Also propose a two-column handout: left = battlecard (callouts + counterpoints), right = quick play (talking lines + demo checklist).
maria: Love that. Final ask: one-pager + landing form rules + verified benchmark by tomorrow 5pm. Assigning: devon one-pager, samir landing rules + webhook sketch, aj run benchmarks follow-up w/eng-infra, elaine headline + slide templates.
tara: Ill update the GA form schema and add the hidden token estimate. Will push PR and drop link here when done.
ops-bot: eng-infra assigned @kevin to produce bmk-2027-11-10-trimmed by 15:00 PT.
maria: Perfect. If we hit this cadence we can lock webinar copy and route demo requests straight to AE queue. Thanks team! :rocket:
